info.title: Custodia eDiscovery
info.description: Microsoft Graph eDiscovery (Premium) surface for a FOIA / public-records agent. Delegated (on-behalf-of) auth only; every call is bounded by the signed-in reviewer's own Purview eDiscovery role. Covers case, custodian, search, review set, tagging and export operations. Deliberately omits case deletion, purgeData, and legal hold creation or removal - those remain manual actions in the Purview portal.

scopes.eDiscovery.ReadWrite.All: Read and write eDiscovery cases and searches as the signed-in user.
scopes.User.Read: Sign in and read the signed-in user's profile.

post.summary: Add search results to a review set
post.description: Starts collecting the results of a search into a review set. This moves real content and is asynchronous: it returns 202 with a Location header. Poll ListCaseOperations until the operation completes. Requires explicit reviewer confirmation, and the search should be estimated first so the reviewer knows the volume.

parameters.name: ediscoveryCaseId
parameters.description: The ID of the eDiscovery case.

parameters.name: ediscoveryReviewSetId
parameters.description: The ID of the review set.

202.description: The collection into the review set has started.

Location.description: URL of the operation created to handle this request. Poll it for status.

post.description: Starts an export of a review set. This produces the production package and is the most consequential operation in the connector. Never call it without confirmed release approval from authorized records or legal personnel. Asynchronous: returns 202 with a Location header.

parameters.name: ediscoveryCaseId
parameters.description: The ID of the eDiscovery case.

parameters.name: ediscoveryReviewSetId
parameters.description: The ID of the review set.

Location.description: URL of the operation created to handle this request. Poll it for status.

get.summary: List legal holds in a case
get.description: Read-only view of the legal holds in the case, so the reviewer can see what is preserved. Creating and removing holds is deliberately not available through this connector.

parameters.name: ediscoveryCaseId
parameters.description: The ID of the eDiscovery case.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return.

200.description: The legal holds in the case.

displayName.description: The display name of the case. Use the team's FOIA naming pattern.

description.description: A description of the case, for example the request reference and the requested date range.

displayName.description: The display name of the search.

contentQuery.description: The KQL (Keyword Query Language) query string used for the search.

dataSourceScopes.description: The scope of the search across the tenant.

statisticsOptions.description: Comma-separated statistics options. Possible values: includeRefiners, includeQueryStats, includeUnindexedStats, advancedIndexing, locationsWithoutHits. advancedIndexing and locationsWithoutHits are only considered when includeUnindexedStats is set.

displayName.description: The display name of the case.

status.description: The case status, for example active or closed.

lastModifiedDateTime.description: When the case was last modified.

closedDateTime.description: When the case was closed, if applicable.

externalId.description: The external case reference, if set.

@odata.nextLink.description: Link to the next page of results.

displayName.description: The display name of the search.

contentQuery.description: The KQL query string used for the search.

dataSourceScopes.description: The scope of the search across the tenant.

lastModifiedDateTime.description: When the search was last modified.

action.description: The action the operation performs, for example estimateStatistics.

status.description: The operation status. Possible values include notStarted, submissionFailed, running, succeeded, partiallySucceeded, failed.

@odata.nextLink.description: Link to the next page of results.

indexedItemCount.description: The number of indexed items matching the search.

indexedItemsSize.description: The total size in bytes of indexed items matching the search.

unindexedItemCount.description: The number of unindexed items matching the search.

unindexedItemsSize.description: The total size in bytes of unindexed items matching the search.

mailboxCount.description: The number of mailboxes with hits.

siteCount.description: The number of sites with hits.

externalId.description: External case or request number for cross-reference.

holdStatus.description: Whether a hold is applied to this custodian.

releasedDateTime.description: When the custodian was released, if released.

createdDateTime.description: When the data source was added.

contentQuery.description: New KQL content query. Changing this changes the meaning of the records request - restate it to the reviewer first.

createdDateTime.description: When the review set was created.

id.description: The ID of the search whose results should be collected.

additionalDataOptions.description: Comma-separated extra data to collect. Values: allVersions, linkedFiles, advancedIndexing, listAttachments, htmlTranscripts, messageConversationExpansion, locationsWithoutHits, allItemsInFolder.

cloudAttachmentVersion.description: How many cloud attachment versions to collect.

documentVersion.description: How many document versions to collect.

exportOptions.description: Comma-separated format options. Values: originalFiles, text, pdfReplacement, tags, splitSource, includeFolderAndPath, friendlyName, condensePaths. Summary and load files are always included.

exportStructure.description: Packaging structure for the export. Prefer pst or msg; directory is deprecated.

childSelectability.description: Whether child tags are single- or multi-select.

isEnabled.description: Whether the hold is currently enabled.
